page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.10xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 40 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 2.4 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 38,381.56 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 11,735.0. The Intel Xeon processor supports AVX-512 vector extensions, contributing to a Passmark CPU extended instructions score of 35,311.94. Memory performance shows a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 2,132.58 GB/sec, which drops to 105.52 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Redis SET operations reach 34.66 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput is measured at 23.2 GB/sec.

The instance offers dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring consistent compute performance without resource sharing. However, the lack of bundled local storage and GPU accelerators limits its applicability for workloads requiring high-speed local disk I/O or hardware-accelerated machine learning. Qualitatively, the high-frequency CPU cores provide cost-efficient processing power for compute-bound tasks that do not require massive memory footprints. This profile is suitable for workloads such as software compilation, web serving, database operations, and moderate-scale multi-threaded decompression tasks.
